message.reasoning:
I need to decide on a Monopoly action.

Cash dropped from $614 to $64 after paying $550 rent on VERMONT_AVENUE. All other properties except BOARDWALK are mortgaged.

p1 has a strong orange monopoly with hotels and $1,196 cash. p2 is bankrupt. p4 has $797 and many mortgaged properties. I can mortgage BOARDWALK for $200 to raise cash.

I'm reconsidering the early mortgage of BOARDWALK. With only $64 cash, I need to survive the next turn's rent payments. I'm mapping the board order to plan my next move from VERMONT_AVENUE.

Rolling from VERMONT_AVENUE lands on several properties. A 2 would hit CONNECTEDTOWN with a $600 hotel rent. A 7 would hit PENNSYLVANIA_RAILROAD for $100. A 8 would hit ST_JAMES with an orange hotel. Most other spaces are mortgaged and cost nothing.

St. James Place hotel rent is $950, which would wipe out my remaining $64 cash. I'm now mapping the exact sequence of spaces from Vermont Avenue to plan the safest next move.

Rolling a 2 on CONNECTEDTOWN would cost $600. Even with the $200 mortgage, I would still be $36 short. Rolling a 7 on PENNSYLVANIA_RAILROAD costs $100. That is manageable with the mortgage. I am now checking the remaining spaces.

Rolls 9, 11, and 12 are also fatal. Only rolls 3 through 7 are safe from immediate bankruptcy. The safest outcomes are landing on Jail, St. Charles Place, Electric Company, States Avenue, or Virginia Avenue.

I am weighing whether to mortgage Boardwalk now. Rolling a 7 on Pennsylvania Railroad costs $100, which is manageable with the mortgage. However, the previous strategy was to avoid early mortgages because the debt phase can handle it later and preserves the only rent-generating property.

I am now considering a trade. I could offer p1 my unmortgaged Illinois Avenue to complete their red monopoly, though they might build hotels afterward. I also need to check whether p4 owns yellows.

I now see that p4 only owns Ventnor among yellows, and I hold both Atlantic and Marvin. I also block p4 from greens with my unmortgaged Pacific. I have a dark blue monopoly of Park Place and Boardwalk, but Park Place is mortgaged and costs $193 to unmortgage. With only $64 cash, I cannot unmortgage it.

Mortgaging Boardwalk would leave only $71 after paying to unmortgage Park Place. That is too little to survive a roll on Connecticut or even Pennsylvania Railroad. Unmortgaging Park Place is therefore impossible.

I am now looking at trading. p1 wants Illinois Avenue to complete their red monopoly, but they still need to unmortgage Kentucky and Indiana before building.

Unmortgaging p1's red properties would cost $330 plus Illinois at $132. They could then build hotels and bankrupt me quickly. I would need to pay them heavily to unmortgage my dark blues and build houses, which costs $400. That trade is too expensive.

Trading away Boardwalk or Park Place would give p4 or p1 a complete color group they could develop, which is catastrophic. p4 already has light blue and purple hotels. I am now considering trading with p1 to hurt p4 instead.

I am now considering a passive survival strategy. With only $64 cash and no income properties unmortgaged except Boardwalk, I cannot afford to build or trade. The focus is simply staying alive until p1 and p4 bankrupt each other. p1 has just been sent to jail with $1,196 and orange hotels, while p4 has $797 and five hotels on light blues and purples. They will likely hit each other with their existing hotels. p1 may pay the $50 bail to leave or attempt to roll doubles.

I am now considering a trade to sell my mortgaged Electric Company for cash. It would not give away a monopoly, and p4 already owns Water Works, so the combined utility rent would be modest. I also confirmed that p1 would not pay for Illinois Avenue, since that would complete their red monopoly.

I will end the turn. I will not mortgage Boardwalk preemptively or trade away blockers and dark blues. The $64 cash is tight, but the debt phase can handle a mortgage if I land on Pennsylvania Railroad.

I realized that even with a $200 mortgage, landing on a hotel would still bankrupt me. I am now checking whether the trade schema allows trading properties without buildings, which would let me acquire cash while forcing opponents to sell their hotels.

The trade schema does not allow trading properties that have buildings on them, so I cannot acquire hotelled properties through a trade. I will end the turn without proposing any trades.
